data.title: Fantasy Player News
data.description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Alec Pierce (heel) set to play Sunday, snap count undetermined
items.desc: Alec Pierce (heel) is set to play in Sunday's game against the Baltimore Ravens, although the team has yet to make a decision on a possible snap count for him.
items.impact: Pierce is going to be available to suit up for the team's season opener on Sunday. That's great news for the Colts, but they still have yet to determine if he will be a full go or if he will be on a snap count. Fantasy managers should pay attention to any updates about his workload heading into the weekend, as his fantasy value in this matchup will largely hinge on whether or not the team limits his reps.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyson Bagent (back) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Tyson Bagent (back) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Carolina Panthers.
items.impact: Bagent is at risk of missing Chicago's season opener on Sunday. He wasn't able to practice at all this week, so it seems that he has an uphill battle to be active this weekend. If he's ruled out, Case Keenum will serve as Chicago's backup in his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rome Odunze (calf) questionable to play Sunday
items.desc: Rome Odunze (calf) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Carolina Panthers.
items.impact: Odunze has been limited at practice all week due to a calf injury, and now it is threatening to leave him sidelined for the team's season opener on Sunday. He is officially considered questionable to play, and the team will make a final determination about his availability closer to game time. Luther Burden III will be a great fantasy option if Odunze is ruled out, with Zavion Thomas also likely to step up and see more work.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Malik Davis carted out of practice Friday
items.desc: Malik Davis left Friday's practice on a cart after going down with an injury of some kind.
items.impact: Davis suffered an injury during Dallas' practice on Friday and had to be carted off. The team has not yet determined the severity of the injury, but it seems likely to be serious enough to leave him sidelined in Week 1 at least. He was primed to be Dallas' RB2 behind Javonte Williams, so now Emari Demercado will have to step up and play that role in Davis' likely absence for the season opener.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bo Melton released by Packers
items.desc: The Packers released WR Bo Melton.
items.impact: Melton made the move back to being a full-time wide receiver this offseason. He will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Audric Estime (thigh) won't play Sunday
items.desc: Audric Estime (thigh) won't play in Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: The Saints will be without Estime on Sunday, who is going to be sidelined due to a nagging thigh injury of some kind. His absence isn't expected to have much of an impact from a fantasy perspective.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Alvin Kamara (knee) officially questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Alvin Kamara (knee) is officially questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Kamara will enter the weekend with a questionable tag. This doesn't come as much of a surprise, given that he has been limited at practice all week while dealing with this knee injury. Fantasy managers should expect more work for Kendre Miller if the veteran is ruled out ahead of game time on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zachariah Branch (hamstring) off injury report for Sunday
items.desc: Zachariah Branch (hamstring) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: The rookie was limited at practice earlier in the week due to a hamstring injury, but he is over it now and is off of the injury report ahead of Sunday's game. He isn't expected to be a strong fantasy option against the Steelers, however, especially with Cooper Rush set to start at QB for the Falcons in the absence of Tua Tagovailoa (oblique).

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Hancock (quad) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Jordan Hancock is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Texans.
items.impact: Hancock returned to a limited practice on Thursday after being sidelined on Wednesday. He'll be a game-time decision on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: T.J. Sanders (knee) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: T.J. Sanders is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Texans.
items.impact: Sanders did not practice on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday. He'll be a game-time decision on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ty Johnson (hamstring) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Ty Johnson is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Texans.
items.impact: Johnson returned to practice on Friday. If he is cleared, he'll remain in a depth role in the Bills backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dadrion Taylor-Demerson (ribs) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Dadrion Taylor-Demerson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
items.impact: Taylor-Demerson did not practice on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday. He'll be sidelined for the season opener on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Garrett Williams (Achilles) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Garrett Williams has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
items.impact: Williams suffered a season-ending torn Achilles in Week 16 last year. He was limited in practice this week, so it's possible he'll be ready to go for Week 2.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Isaiah Adams (knee) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Isaiah Adams has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
items.impact: Adams was unable to practice all week. He'll be sidelined for at least one game to start the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) expected to be gameday decision Sunday
items.desc: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said it was fair to say Jeremiyah Love will be gameday decision on Sunday.
items.impact: All reports this week have suggested Love is expected to play on Sunday. Barring any late setback, he should be good to go. It is unclear if he'll be limited in any fashion.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Eli Stowers (hamstring) says he expects to play Sunday
items.desc: Eagles rookie TE Eli Stowers told reporters he believes he is going to play on Sunday against the Commanders.
items.impact: Stowers has been battling a hamstring injury. He'll remain off the fantasy radar to begin the season behind Dallas Goedert.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jack Strand to be backup QB for Falcons Sunday
items.desc: Jack Strand will enter Sunday's season opener for the Falcons as the backup quarterback.
items.impact: Tua Tagovailoa was ruled out with an oblique injury. Cooper Rush will get the start as a result.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) will play in Week 1
items.desc: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) will play in Week 1 for the Washington Commanders against the Philadelphia Eagles according to Ian Rapoport.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: K'Lavon Chaisson (knee) will play in Week 1
items.desc: K'Lavon Chaisson (knee) will play in Week 1 for the Washington Commanders against the Philadelphia Eagles.
items.impact: Chaisson is good to go after progressing throughout the practice week without any setbacks for head coach Dan Quinn as the Washington defense will look to keep a strong Philadelphia ground game in check Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cooper Rush will start Sunday for Falcons
items.desc: Cooper Rush has been named the starter for the Falcons on Sunday against the Steelers.
items.impact: Tua Tagovailoa was ruled out with an oblique injury. Rush took all the first-team reps in practice on Thursday and Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Falcons QB Tua Tagovailoa has been ruled out for Sunday's season opener against the Steelers.
items.impact: Tagovailoa went down in practice on Thursday and did not practice on Friday. With Michael Penix Jr. not available yet, it will be Cooper Rush drawing the start on Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Daron Payne (knee) will play in Week 1
items.desc: Daron Payne (knee) will play in Week 1 for the Washington Commanders against the Philadelphia Eagles according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: Payne will suit up for head coach Dan Quinn after progressing through a short practice week without any issues. The defensive tackle will look to stifle a Philadelphia rushing attack led by running back Saquon Barkley and quarterback Jalen Hurts in the season opener.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Odafe Oweh (calf) will play in Week 1
items.desc: Odafe Oweh (calf) will play in Week 1 for the Washington Commanders against the Philadelphia Eagles according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: Oweh will suit up after practicing as the week progressed for head coach Dan Quinn as the defense lineman will be tasked with slowing down a Philadelphia ground attack led by superstar running back Saquon Barkley.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Parker Brailsford (thumb) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Parker Brailsford is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Brailsford has been limited due to a thumb injury. The rookie's status will need to be monitored closer to Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Teven Jenkins (back) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Teven Jenkins has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Jenkins was unable to practice this week due to a back injury. He'll miss at least one game to begin the season.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Sean Tucker (hamstring) doubtful for Week 1
items.desc: Sean Tucker (hamstring) is doubtful to play in Week 1 for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers against the Cincinnati Bengals according to Greg Auman.
items.impact: Tucker seems poised to sit out Tampa Bay's season opening contest against the Bengals as he continues to work back from injury, with Bucky Irving and Kenneth Gainwell to share backfield duties for head coach Todd Bowles Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jalen McMillan (knee) doubtful for Week 1
items.desc: Jalen McMillan (knee) is doubtful to play in Week 1 for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers against the Cincinnati Bengals according to Greg Auman.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Emeka Egbuka (toe) cleared for Week 1
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka (toe) is cleared to play in Week 1 for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers against the Cincinnati Bengals according to Greg Auman.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jonathon Brooks (groin) not expected to face snap count Sunday
items.desc: The Panthers say RB Jonathon Brooks will not face a snap count on Sunday against the Bears.
items.impact: Brooks was able to practice three straight days this week. It remains unclear what the split between him and Chuba Hubbard will look like heading into the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Penix Jr. cleared and considered healthy
items.desc: Michael Penix Jr. is reportedly cleared and considered to be healthy.
items.impact: Penix will still be inactive for Week 1. He added that he's not where he feels he needs to be right now. He isn't expected to be sidelined for too much longer.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase (knee) cleared for Week 1
items.desc: Ja'Marr Chase (knee) has been cleared to play in Week 1 for the Cincinnati Bengals against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers according to Kelsey Conway.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tee Higgins (foot) cleared for Week 1
items.desc: Tee Higgins (foot) is cleared to play in Week 1 for the Cincinnati Bengals against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers according to Kelsey Conway.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Darren Waller yet to be cleared for Week 1
items.desc: Darren Waller has yet to be cleared for Week 1 for the Carolina Panthers according to Steve Reed.
items.impact: Waller has practiced consistently throughout the week and is "good to go" according to head coach Dave Canales, but still needs to to be placed on the active roster ahead of Sunday's matchup with the Chicago Bears.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: A.J. Brown (ankle) placed on injured reserve
items.desc: A.J. Brown (ankle) has been placed on injured reserve by the New England Patriots according to Adam Schefter.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Malik Nabers (knee) preparing to practice Friday
items.desc: Malik Nabers (knee) was seen warming up on the sidelines to prepare for Friday's practice according to Jordan Raanan.
items.impact: Nabers has practiced fully the entire week for head coach John Harbaugh, putting the superstar wideout on track to suit up for Sunday's season opener against the Dallas Cowboys and providing a boost to a Giants offense looking to put a forgettable 2025-26 in the rearview mirror.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Bobby Brown III (back) participates in Friday's practice
items.desc: Bobby Brown III (back) participated in Friday's practice and should be available for Sunday's season opener.
items.impact: Brown was limited at practice earlier in the week due to a back issue, but he looked good to go in Friday's session. Brown should be a starter up front for the Panthers' defense. He played in all 17 games last season, totaling 31 tackles with 0.5 sacks and one pass defended.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ronnie Harrison Jr. (hamstring) expected to play Sunday
items.desc: Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley said he expects to have S Ronnie Harrison Jr. available for the opener on Sunday.
items.impact: Harrison has been limited in practice all week. He is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Raiders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Will Kacmarek (calf) expected to play Sunday
items.desc: Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley said he expects to have TE Will Kacmarek available for the opener on Sunday.
items.impact: Kacmarek has been limited in practice all week. He is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Raiders.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: DJ Turner II (hamstring) practices Friday
items.desc: DJ Turner II (hamstring) took part in Friday's practice session.
items.impact: Turner has been bothered by a hamstring issue lately, but it looks promising that he will be good to go for Sunday's season opener. Turner played in all 17 games for the Bengals last season, recording 40 total tackles with two interceptions and two forced fumbles.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mohamoud Diabate to be elevated Sunday by Titans
items.desc: LB Mohamoud Diabate will be a game day elevation for the Titans on Sunday.
items.impact: Diabate will add depth in the linebacker room for the Titans in their season opener with Cedric Gray ruled out.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cedric Gray (concussion) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Cedric Gray has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jets.
items.impact: Gray was placed on concussion protocol earlier this week. He will miss at least one game as a result.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jamari Thrash waived by Browns
items.desc: The Browns have waived WR Jamari Thrash from injured reserve.
items.impact: Thrash will figure to seek another opportunity early in the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Derrick Moore (hamstring) expected to play Sunday
items.desc: Lions head coach Dan Campbell said he feels good about Derrick Moore's chances of playing on Sunday.
items.impact: Moore has been limited in practice all week due to a hamstring injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Mahogany expected to start at left guard Sunday
items.desc: Lions head coach Dan Campbell said there is a good chance that Christian Mahogany starts at left guard on Sunday against the Saints.
items.impact: Mahogany was competing for the starting left guard job all offseason, which he won heading into Week 1.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: DaQuan Jones to sign with Patriots
items.desc: DaQuan Jones is expected to sign with the Patriots on Friday.
items.impact: Jones will give the Patriots some added strength on the defensive front heading into Week 2. The 12-year veteran played 12 games for the Bills last season, recording 22 total tackles, three sacks, and one forced fumble.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Joseph Ossai (foot) out for Week 1
items.desc: Joseph Ossai (foot) will not play in Week 1 against the Titans.
items.impact: Ossai had been considered week-to-week with his foot injury. Now, it's been confirmed that he will miss the season opener. Ossai was a free-agent acquisition this offseason for the Jets after recording five sacks in each of the past two seasons for the Bengals.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Tim Patrick (groin) out for Week 1
items.desc: Tim Patrick (groin) won't be available for Sunday's season opener.
items.impact: Patrick has yet to return to practice, so it's no surprise that he will not play in Week 1. The veteran receiver signed with the Jets this offseason after catching 15 passes with three touchdowns over 16 games for the Jaguars last season.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Kene Nwangwu (back) doubtful for Week 1
items.desc: Kene Nwangwu (back) has been listed as doubtful for Sunday's season opener.
items.impact: Nwangwu has been dealing with a back issue and will likely sit out Sunday's game in Tennessee. Nwangwu does most of his work on special teams for the Jets. He has returned five kicks for touchdowns over his five seasons, including one last year.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jason Sanders to kick for Jets on Sunday
items.desc: Jason Sanders will kick for the Jets on Sunday, rather than Blake Gruppe. Sanders gets a promotion from the practice squad.
items.impact: Sanders lad got a chance in Miami in 2024, and has hit field goals at a near 85% clip. He should be a solid kicker for the Jets, but for fantasy it's not incredibly appealing given the questions surrounding the Jets offense.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: D'Angelo Ponds (calf) doubtful for Sunday
items.desc: D'Angelo Ponds (calf) is doubtful for Sunday's season opener against the Titans.
items.impact: Ponds has been trying to make his way back in time for his first NFL game, but it looks like he will have to wait at least one more week. Ponds was selected in the second round of this year's draft by the Jets after winning a national championship at Indiana last season.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Brevyn Spann-Ford inks extension with Cowboys
items.desc: Brevyn Spann-Ford signed a three-year contract extension with the Cowboys on Thursday.
items.impact: After originally signing as an undrafted free agent, Spann-Ford has played in 17 games each of the last two seasons for the Cowboys. He's not been much of a pass catcher, but the 26-year-old tight end has excelled as a blocker and special-teams contributor.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jake Tonges (knee) to be further evaluated
items.desc: Jake Tonges (knee) exited Thursday's game early and will be further evaluated Friday.
items.impact: After Thursday's win, San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said simply that it "wasn't good," regarding Tonges' injury. The early reports suggest an MCL injury, but the 27-year-old tight end's status should become more clear on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Atonio Mafi waived by Raiders
items.desc: The Raiders waived OL Atonio Mafi.
items.impact: Mafi will seek another opportunity early in the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bryce Cabeldue claimed off waivers by Raiders
items.desc: The Raiders claimed OL Bryce Cabeldue off waivers.
items.impact: Cabeldue was waived by the Seahawks. He will reunite with Klint Kubiak with Las Vegas.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tom Kennedy signs with Lions active roster
items.desc: The Lions signed WR Tom Kennedy to their active roster.
items.impact: Kennedy will be returning punts this year for Detroit.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Melvin Smith Jr. waived by Titans

items.impact: Smith will figure to seek another opportunity early in the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylon Jones signs with Titans
items.desc: The Titans signed CB Jaylon Jones to the team's 53-man roster.
items.impact: Jones will add depth in the corner back room for Tennessee.

items.title: Carlos Allen Jr. released by Falcons
items.desc: The Falcons released DL Carlos Allen Jr.
items.impact: Allen will figure to seek another opportunity early in the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zacch Pickens signs with Falcons
items.desc: The Falcons signed DL Zacch Pickens.
items.impact: Pickens was previously released by the Giants. He'll add depth on the defensive line for Atlanta.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cole Van Lanen (knee) to be game-time decision Sunday
items.desc: Cole Van Lanen will be a game-time decision for Sunday's game against the Browns.
items.impact: The status of Van Lanen is up in the air due to a knee injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Laken Tomlinson signs with Cowboys
items.desc: The Cowboys signed OL Laken Tomlinson to their practice squad.
items.impact: Tomlinson will add depth on the offensive line for Dallas to begin the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Leverett signs with Cowboys active roster
items.desc: The Cowboys signed OL Nick Leverett to their active roster.
items.impact: Leverett will add depth on the offensive line for Dallas to begin the season with Tyler Smith placed on IR.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Smith (thumb) placed on IR
items.desc: The Cowboys placed OL Tyler Smith on injured reserve.
items.impact: Smith underwent surgery on his thumb. He will miss at least the first four games of the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyonte Hamilton reaches injury settlement with Texans
items.desc: The Texans removed Kyonte Hamilton from injured reserve with an injury settlement.
items.impact: Hamilton was dealing with a knee injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenny Fletcher Jr. signs with Colts
items.desc: The Colts signed TE Kenny Fletcher Jr. to their practice squad.
items.impact: Fletcher will add depth in the tight end room for the Colts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Luke Tenuta signs with Colts active roster
items.desc: The Colts signed OL Luke Tenuta to their active roster.
items.impact: Tenuta was previously on the practice squad for Indianapolis.

items.title: Wes Pahl released by Browns
items.desc: The Browns released Wes Pahl.
items.impact: Pahl will figure to seek another opportunity early in the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bryce Oliver released by Browns
items.desc: The Browns released WR Bryce Oliver.
items.impact: Oliver will figure to seek another opportunity early in the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nadame Tucker signs with Browns
items.desc: The Browns signed Nadame Tucker to their practice squad.
items.impact: Tucker will hold a depth role heading into the season for Cleveland.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bub Means signs with Browns
items.desc: The Browns signed WR Bub Means to their practice squad.
items.impact: Means was previously waived by the Saints. He will add depth in the wide receiver room for Cleveland.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jeremiah Moon signs with Panthers
items.desc: The Panthers signed LB Jeremiah Moon.
items.impact: Moon will add depth in the linebacker room for Carolina heading into the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ka'ena De Cambra released by Texans
items.desc: The Texans released C Ka'ena De Cambra.
items.impact: Cambra will figure to seek another opportunity heading into the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Gavin Gerhardt signs with Texans
items.desc: The Texans signed C Gavin Gerhardt to their practice squad.
items.impact: Gerhardt will add depth on the offensive line for Houston heading into the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow

items.desc: The Texans signed QB Mark Gronowski to their practice squad.
items.impact: Gronkowski will add depth in the quarterback room for Houston heading into the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dominic Bailey released by Texans
items.desc: The Texans released DL Dominic Bailey.
items.impact: Bailey will figure to seek another opportunity heading into the season.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Ryan Flournoy agrees to one-year, $6 million extension with Dallas
items.desc: Ryan Flournoy has agreed to a one-year extension with the Dallas Cowboys worth $6 millloon.
items.impact: Flournoy flashed at times last year and is expected to take on a larger role in 2026. He's coming off of a great second season in the league that saw him snag 40 passes for nearly 500 yards and four touchdowns, including two games with more than 110 yards.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Eddy Pineiro racks up 9 kicking points in win
items.desc: Eddy Pineiro made two of three field goal attempts and all three of his PAT's in the 49ers' 27-7 win over the Rams.
items.impact: Pineiro had a solid game overall, though I'm sure he wishes that he could go back and have another try at the one he missed. As long as he is healthy and active and the Niners' offense keeps this up, he should be just fine for fantasy.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Demarcus Robinson catches long touchdown in win
items.desc: Demarcus Robinson caught two of three targets for 50 yards and a score in the 49ers' 27-7 win over the Rams on Thursday night.
items.impact: Robinson had a red zone target in this game as well, but failed to snag the short pass. His long touchdown saved his fantasy day, but it's worth asking: how many fantasy managers did it truly save?

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Kaelon Black impresses in win over Rams
items.desc: Kaelon Black ran 14 times for 65 yards and caught his only target for five yards in the 49ers' 27-7 win over the Rams on Thursday.
items.impact: Black was in a full-on committee with Christian McCaffrey, something few, if any, saw coming. Both were tied at 15 touches apiece, but McCaffrey led in total opportunities thanks to seeing more targets. Black won't have games like this all the time, but he's showing himself to be a valuable handcuff that CMC managers will need to snag when they can.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Deebo Samuel Sr. snags touchdown in win
items.desc: Deebo Samuel Sr. caught six of seven targets for 48 yards and a touchdown in the 49ers' 27-7 win over the Rams on Thursday. He also carried the ball once for 12 yards.
items.impact: Samuel looks to have come back to his old role on the 49ers, lining up everywhere and getting the ball put in his hands to make plays. He even had over 70 kick return yards. Samuel just might be a draft-day steal if they are going to use him like this throughout the season.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Brock Purdy dismantles Rams defense in statement win
items.desc: Brock Purdy completed 25-of-34 passes for 205 yards, three touchdowns, and a pick in the 49ers' 27-7 win over the Rams on Thursday. He also ran five times for 29 yards.
items.impact: Purdy was great in this game aside from a couple of hiccups, namely the interception. However, he did what he needed to and got the Niners into scoring position and helped them take advantage of the several short fields they inherited. Purdy should be a solid asset moving forward for fantasy.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: George Kittle snags two passes in win
items.desc: George Kittle caught two of five targets for 12 yards in the 49ers' 27-7 demolition of the Rams on Thursday.
items.impact: Kittle was involved, that's for sure, but his small output won't cut it for fantasy managers who are relying on him. As he continues to ramp up and recover from his Achilles tear, he should see his involvement tick upwards.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Mike Evans snags touchdown in 49ers debut
items.desc: Mike Evans caught six of seven targets for 49 yards and a touchdown in the 49ers' 27-7 blowout win over the Rams on Thursday.
items.impact: Evans had a nice end zone fade touchdown over a Rams DB who was draped all over him, as well as plenty of third-down usage. He's looking like a potential draft-day steal if his momentum keeps up. This is especially true if De'Zhaun Stribling misses extended time with an ankle injury.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Christian McCaffrey racks up 88 scrimmage yards in win
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey ran 10 times for 68 yards and caught five of eight targets for 20 yards in the 49ers' 27-7 win over the Rams on Thursday.
items.impact: McCaffrey surprisingly had a split backfield with Kaelon Black, at least much more than expected. The veteran tied Black in touches, 15 to 15, but had the edge in opportunities, 18 to 15, thanks to receiving. It will be interesting to see if this is a Week 1 fluke or a recurring theme, as Black was involved throughout the game, not just when the game was well in hand. Still, CMC is a top-tier asset, and while today was fine, bigger days are ahead.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: De'Zhaun Stribling (ankle) suffers ankle injury Thursday, Achilles is OK
items.desc: De'Zhaun Stribling (ankle) suffered an ankle injury on Thursday against the Rams, but his Achilles is intact. Before leaving the Niners' 27-7 win, Stribling failed to record a stat.
items.impact: While the rookie failed to put up anything in the box score, he was playing the majority of the offensive snaps before he left due to the injury. He will likely miss time, but his usage early on is encouraging, and it will be interesting to see how the team treats him when he returns.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Harrison Mevis kicks single PAT in loss to Niners
items.desc: Harrison Mevis made his only PAT attempt in the Rams' 27-7 tough loss to the 49ers.
items.impact: Mevis wasn't called upon much, the Rams offense was just never in scoring position for most of the game. He could have come in in the second half, but the Rams elected to go for it on 4th and goal at the 1 yard line, which was the correct choice, but their failure to convert meant Mevis was going to have an even bigger stinker. Brighter days are ahead for the Rams kicker.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Los Angeles Rams D/ST run over by 49ers
items.desc: The Los Angeles Rams' D/ST was completely destroyed by the 49ers' offense, and it didn't help that the Rams' offense was equally outmatched, making the final result all the more stark.
items.impact: The Rams still have plenty of star talent on this side of the ball, so don't overreact to one week of football. They should be just fine as the season rolls along once they find their footing.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Terrance Ferguson quiet in loss to 49ers
items.desc: Terrance Ferguson failed to catch his lone target in the Rams' 27-7 blowout loss to the 49ers.
items.impact: The hopeful breakout for Ferguson came to a screeching halt on Thursday, with the tight end failing to garner a target until late in the game, and failing to bring it in at that. However, the entire Rams offense was dysfunctional; no one had a great day for fantasy aside from maybe Kyren Williams and Puka Nacua, depending on your criteria. And second, Ferguson was present on most of the snaps when the starters were in, a big increase from his part time role in 2025. Hopefully, with his snaps now increased, the targets will come. We may just have to wait a week for the Rams to figure out what happened to them and get back on track.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Blake Corum totals 54 yards in loss
items.desc: Blake Corum ran 10 times for 54 yards in the Rams' 27-7 loss to the 49ers on Thursday.
items.impact: Corum was solid on the ground at 5.4 a carry, but that was about all he had going for him. Without a touchdown or receiving work to go along with his yardage, it was a disappointing fantasy performance. However, his usage is encouraging; the Rams at least trust him enough that they will split Kyren Williams' workload with Corum. It makes him a top-tier handcuff RB, and one that should be rostered in case anything happens to Kyren.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Davante Adams quiet in loss to 49ers
items.desc: Davante Adams caught just three of six targets for 26 yards in the Rams' 27-7 loss to the 49ers on Thursday.
items.impact: Adams could just not get much going against the Niners. On the bright side, his six targets were second on the team, so he's still earning opportunities. It just wasn't his day, as was the story for most of the team. He will try to improve next time out.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Puka Nacua goes for 74 yards in loss
items.desc: Puka Nacua caught five of nine targets for 74 yards in the Rams' 27-7 loss to the Niners on Thursday.
items.impact: Puka was the only Ram who had more than 26 receiving yards, and most of those yards came on a nice catch and run early on in the game. His final total was respectable, but fantasy managers will hope for more next time he's out on the field.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Kyren Williams punches in score in loss to Niners
items.desc: Kyren Williams ran 11 times for 41 yards and the Rams' only touchdown. He also caught all three of his targets for 24 receiving yards.
items.impact: Williams' day was saved by the touchdown; otherwise it was fairly miserable. Blake Corum showed out in his opportunities, but he was limited to ground work only. Kyren appears to be in a committee now, but he at least has the edge in passing situations, giving him more appeal.
